_doc: Gemini CLI. Verified against @google/gemini-cli-core 0.58.0: chatRecordingService writes one JSONL file per session under the project's temp dir, chatRecordingTypes declares the record shape, and telemetry/uiTelemetry computes fresh input as `prompt - cached` — which is why input_is_total is true here. The session id is not on any message record; it lives in the filename, and a subagent's transcript is nested under its parent session id. See from_path.
